card.name: Dosing status words: not established, not recommended
card.fires_on: The word that completes a dosing statement, such as 'established' after 'has not been', 'recommended' after 'not', or 'therapy' in dose-modification headings. It also fires partway through 'administer' and 'administration'.

modes.label: Not established / not recommended
modes.description: The final word of a statement that a dose or use is not established or not recommended.
modes.example: Do not use ritonavir with avanafil because a safe and effective avanafil dosage regimen has not been<< established>>.

modes.label: Therapy in dosing headings
modes.description: The word 'therapy' in dose-modification headings or duration statements.
modes.example: 2.4 Dose Modifications and Reinitiation of<< Therapy>> after Adverse Reactions Hematologic

modes.label: Inside administer words
modes.description: Partway through 'administer' or 'administration' in dosing and interaction text.
modes.example: Drug Interactions: Co-admin<<istration>> of a number of CYP3A
